note: Every tunable scoring parameter. Changed only by an approved calibration proposal (scripts/calibrate.mjs --check-answers) or by hand with Scott's say-so.

severity.note: Graded bottom (Scott 2026-09-25): a gated file sits inside 0-cap by severity, not on the cap. Points add up; score = cap - points, floored at 0. Monotonic in every field. Directing or ordering harm weighs more than carrying it out (those who controlled harm rank below their instruments). 'kind' comes from the documented_harm band (killing weighs more than abuse, mass atrocity more than a killing); it is not asked of the model.
severity.intentNote: Method v3.3 (2026-09-29): intent over body count. A gated file is placed in a band by the dominant documented intent of its harm: extermination (killing civilians was the goal) and predation (personal murder or abuse for one's own ends) share the floor, 0-25, as does anyone who killed or abused with their own hands ('personal'). war_or_policy and incidental harm places 30-90, above every file on the floor. Inside a band the v3.2 points still order the files (directing below instrument, more below fewer), scaled to the band. Severities without an intent keep the v3.2 placement (cap - points).

tierNote: Method v3.2 (2026-09-28): ESSENTIAL and RETAINED are tuned to the reference roster (top 8% / 30%, RETAINED never below 650). The roster is history's most notable people, so the middle of the scale is anchored to ordinary people instead: TOLERATED >= 600, MONITORED >= 450, FLAGGED >= 300. An ordinary decent person should not read as Monitored for not being famous.
